title: Add an idea to the production plan
description:
Synchronous, no credit. Queue a new idea/topic into the account's
production plan (readable via GET /v1/production_plan). Use after
/v1/collect_ideas or /v1/foundation_videos surfaces ideas, or whenever the
user wants to save an idea to work on later. The entry lands with
workflow_phase="queued" (or "ab_roll" when source="template" + a template
is given). idea_text is required; topic_id auto-generates when omitted;
industry falls back to the account's saved industry.

fields.name: idea_text
fields.label: Idea text (required — the idea/topic line)
fields.placeholder: Why estate planning matters for young families

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description (optional notes)
fields.placeholder: Hook on the 40% who die intestate; CTA to book a consult.

fields.name: industry
fields.label: Industry (optional — falls back to account industry)

fields.name: week_start
fields.label: week_start (optional unix seconds; defaults to now)

use_cases.title: 📝 Queue an idea into the plan
use_cases.description: Add a single idea. Returns {object:'production_plan_entry', added:true, topic_id, workflow_phase:'queued', industry, source, request_id}. Read it back with GET /v1/production_plan.

request.idea_text: Why estate planning matters for young families
request.description: Hook on the 40% who die intestate; CTA to book a consult.
